deadline.value: PhD applications for Autumn 2027 are due December 8, 2026 (application opens September 15, 2026; decisions February 2027). Send TOEFL/IELTS scores by October 2026.
deadline.quote: PhD Application Autumn September 15, 2026 December 8, 2026 February 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores are considered for the CS PhD.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required and not considered from PhD applicants.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and not considered.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required and not considered from PhD applicants.

supervisor.value: You do not need an advisor to apply; new PhD students spend their first months getting to know faculty before choosing one.
supervisor.quote: Each PhD student spends the first few months becoming better acquainted with the various faculty and their research areas before aligning with a faculty member to pursue their doctoral research.

funding.value: The School of Engineering commits to full funding for all its PhD students.
funding.quote: Stanford Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement; a CS major is not required.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: Autumn entry only. CS itself has no fee waiver; the School of Engineering handles waivers.
